system_label.description: Plain-language identifier for the polynomial vector field family (e.g. 'linear', 'van_der_pol', 'lienard_cubic', 'bautin', 'shi_songling').

degree_n.description: Max polynomial degree of P and Q in dx/dt = P(x,y), dy/dt = Q(x,y).

polynomial_P.description: Symbolic P(x,y) expression for the record (human-readable).

polynomial_Q.description: Symbolic Q(x,y) expression for the record.

critical_point_count.description: Class K pin-slot count: total critical points of the field on R^2.

node_count.description: Critical points with det J > 0 and (trace J)^2 - 4 det J > 0.

focus_count.description: Critical points with det J > 0 and (trace J)^2 - 4 det J < 0, trace J != 0.

center_count.description: Critical points with det J > 0 and trace J = 0.

cascade_orientation_index_sum.description: Class C cascade-orientation: sum of Poincare indices over all critical points (must equal Euler characteristic of phase space).

known_lower_bound_H_n.description: Known lower bound H(n) of limit-cycle count for degree-n polynomial vector fields, per literature.

cascade_predicted_limit_cycle_count.description: Cascade A o L o C o K o I prediction for this specific system.

hurwitz_ratio_n_over_7.description: n / 7: candidate Hurwitz scaling ratio per [[user_stance_substrate_asymptotic_wave_fractal_hopf_phase_boundary_mechanism]] heptadic structure.

hurwitz_ratio_rational_num.description: Class N best-rational num for n/7.

hurwitz_ratio_rational_den.description: Class N best-rational den for n/7.
